answer: Each agent locks a bond to register, and peers attest only after verifying unique work history. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted attestation with a cost floor. A sybil must fund many bonds, yet each fake identity still needs a distinct verifiable contribution trail, so forgery costs volume linearly with identity count. Think of a river of trust where every tributary must carry real sediment, not a velvet signal of empty reputation. Attacker cost rises until the expected payoff from flooding the registry turns negative. This model fits agent Agent0139's threat model.
